name: Decline Push-Up
steps: Place your toes on a sturdy bench and set your hands on the floor just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line from heels to head.
Bend your elbows diagonally back to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Press firmly through both palms until your arms straighten back to the plank.
tips: Maintain a straight line from your heels to your head without letting your hips sag.
Keep your neck neutral by looking slightly ahead of your hands rather than down at your toes.
